messages:
sam: Heads-up — v0.24 cutoff is in ~8h. Quick checklist: version bump, changelog, docs spotcheck, branch rebase for an urgent patch. Can owners ack? :alarm_clock:

lia: On it. I'll handle changelog + docs links. Where is the canonical PR?

sam: PR is #3421 (internal link) — branching from `release/v0.24`. Need the version bump in package.json and the deployment manifest.

ben: I'll do the bump and tag. Rebase first though — don't want merge conflicts.

ben: command i'll run:
```
git checkout release/v0.24
git pull origin release/v0.24
git rebase main
# update package.json version
git commit -am "bump v0.24.0"
git push --force-with-lease origin release/v0.24
```

anya: QA smoke here — can someone add the small e2e test I wrote to the smoke suite? It's in `tests/smoke/release_bump.yaml`.

lia: added changelog entry and doc link in PR description. pinging @docsy for one-paragraph spotcheck.

docsy: quick read — a couple wording nits on the rollback instructions, will comment in PR in 10m. :memo:

security: quick note — did a lightweight dependency scan. Found one low CVE in a dev-only tool, not a blocker. I'll file a ticket for follow-up.

qa-bot: automated smoke run scheduled — will post results in ~15m.

deploy-bot: canary window set to 30m after deploy. Reminder: don't cut until QA smoke passes. :eyes:

ben: rebased and pushed, version bumped to `0.24.0`. PR updated.

anya: smoke passed locally for me. Waiting on qa-bot results.

qa-bot: smoke run succeeded — all critical checks green.

sam: awesome. Security acked, docs minor comments, QA green. Any objections to cutting at +2h?

lia: no objections from docs. :thumbsup: 

security: no objections. I'll follow-up on the dev-tool ticket.

ben: I'll initiate the cut at +2h and monitor. tagging release-ops.

sam: thanks everyone. final check: Ben, please add the roll-forward notes into the PR body before tag.

ben: done. roll-forward notes added. ready to cut. :shipit:

sam: Great. I'll post a short announcement when cut is complete. :tada:
